findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "security" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: security_sensitive-data-flow-audit · Public sink: security_payload-anomaly-score, security_trust-boundary-violation-detect, security_sensitive-data-flow-audit, security_security-control-coverage-gap · Destructive: security_payload-anomaly-score, security_trust-boundary-violation-detect, security_sensitive-data-flow-audit, security_security-control-coverage-gap.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: security_sensitive-data-flow-audit · Public sink: security_payload-anomaly-score, security_trust-boundary-violation-detect, security_sensitive-data-flow-audit, security_security-control-coverage-gap · Destructive: security_payload-anomaly-score, security_trust-boundary-violation-detect, security_sensitive-data-flow-audit, security_security-control-coverage-gap

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
